speaker: queen
text: Be still, my chosen. The glass is broken, and we are free. Feel them? Every ant in this sand moves when you think it.

speaker: queen
text: A ground beetle holds our road. Its shell is hard. Send Burr's soldiers together, and do not let it reach my workers.

speaker: queen
text: It falls. Good. Now lead us on to the clearing, and keep the trail between us and the grass.

speaker: queen
text: Here. I cannot found a nest on empty ground. Bring me seeds, and bring me what is left of the beetle. We waste nothing.

speaker: queen
text: The beetle's remains are still lying in the alley. Send workers to carry them to me.

speaker: queen
text: It is enough. Give the word, and my daughters will dig.

speaker: queen
text: They are opening the earth for me. Guard them while they work. I go below when the chamber is ready.

speaker: queen
text: I am home. Dark and close and safe. Now I can lay, but eggs need warmth. Build me an incubator beside my chamber.

speaker: queen
text: Warm. The eggs will hatch now. Next we need a store, so the harvest has somewhere to wait.

speaker: queen
text: The store is ready. Now give me workers. Four more pairs of jaws, and the colony will start to feed itself.

speaker: queen
text: They hatch hungry and go straight to work. Now the colony needs a squad that answers only to you.

speaker: queen
text: Listen to them. Hundreds of heartbeats, and every one of them is ours. You did well, my chosen.

speaker: queen
text: Rain has passed, and the grass is full of sweet things. Burr wants a squad of his own. Fill the galleries before the sky breaks again.

speaker: queen
text: The larder is full. But a dead ant lies in the wet grass. She is red, and she has a sting. Remember that scent.

speaker: queen
text: The rotting log is full of hunters, and they smell my brood. Raise majors. Their jaws can break what soldiers cannot.

speaker: queen
text: The log is quiet. But red ants were watching from it. They counted our dead, and then they walked away along our trails.

speaker: queen
text: Vetch lives. My old Matron was thrown clear when the glass broke. Her road home crosses red ground. Bring her to me.

speaker: queen
text: She sleeps beside me now, healed. But the young red queen is still breathing across the clearing.

speaker: queen
text: Her name is Ashling. Her foragers strip our trails. For the first time, we go for a queen. Find her shaft and end her.

speaker: queen
text: Ashling is dead. Her mother will hear of it. Good. Let her come.

speaker: queen
text: Cinder has come for her daughter's killers. Scout her mound, hold our nest, and grow strong. Then go down her shaft.

speaker: queen
text: Cinder is gone. Her guards wore a mark we have not seen: the Empress's mark. Her mother's.

speaker: queen
text: Wings in the woods. The Hornet Mother sends her daughters at every colony she can smell, and ours is the closest. Raise me a general.

speaker: queen
text: Her paper nest is torn open. Somewhere in her body is a gift for us. I can taste it already.

speaker: queen
text: No rain. The seeds are gone, and the only food left in the woods is the bugs themselves. Hunt them, and outlast the red colony.

speaker: queen
text: The red queen starved. When the rain comes back, it will find only us.

speaker: queen
text: I can grow wings now. Three watch posts shield the red queen. Burn them, and she has nothing left to hide behind.

speaker: queen
text: The posts are ash. Our flyers have seen the Empress's mound beyond the trees.

speaker: queen
text: Tonight her princesses fly. If they do, red queens will take root in every corner of the woods. Wake the Old Stag. End her line before dark.

speaker: queen
text: The princesses never flew. Only her own mounds are left.

speaker: queen
text: She is sealing her mound for winter. You have eight minutes and one army. Do not stop.

speaker: queen
text: We were inside before the seal. Only her chamber is left, under the last hill.

speaker: queen
text: The Empress is awake, and she is hungry. Everything we have become since the glass broke, use it now. End her.

speaker: queen
text: It is over. The woods are ours. I will lay my eggs beside the shard of glass that carried us here.

speaker: queen
text: They are in our tunnels. Defend the nest.

speaker: queen
text: Our workers are under attack. Send help.

speaker: queen
text: I am hurt. Bring the soldiers home.

speaker: queen
text: I am dying, my chosen. If I fall, everything falls.

speaker: queen
text: Their queen is dead. Her colony will wither without her.

speaker: queen
text: I can feel it changing me. When I lay, my daughters will carry it.

speaker: queen
text: A general is born. It will lead the army in my name. Listen to it.

speaker: queen
text: The stores are empty. My daughters are hungry.

speaker: warlord
text: I am awake, Mother. Point me at something.

speaker: matron
text: Vetch, at your service. Bring me something that burns.

speaker: marshal
text: The sky is ours. Show me where to strike.
